raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Square side length L",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The absolute side length is unspecified.",
      "readings": [
        "L=1, with element spacing 0.25.",
        "L=4, with unit element spacing."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Results, Compliance minimization: specifies a square divided evenly into a 4×4 mesh; Fig. 2a supplies no dimensions."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Total downward force",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No numerical load magnitude is supplied. Its overall scale cancels from the normalized objective.",
      "readings": [
        "Total downward force F=1 in consistent force units.",
        "Total downward force F=100 in the same units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Results, Compliance minimization, problem-setup paragraph; Fig. 2a labels the load only as Force; Eq. (4) normalizes elastic energy."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Solid Young's modulus Y0",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The solid modulus has no numerical value. At fixed ε/Y0, it supplies only an overall stiffness scale.",
      "readings": [
        "Y0=1 in normalized stiffness units.",
        "Y0=210 GPa, with ε chosen using the same residual stiffness ratio."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Results, Compliance minimization, Eq. (6) and its explanatory paragraph define Y0 as a constant without assigning its value."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Residual stiffness ratio ε/Y0",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The void stiffness is described only as small; its ratio to solid stiffness is unspecified.",
      "readings": [
        "ε/Y0=10^-3.",
        "ε/Y0=10^-6.",
        "ε/Y0=10^-9."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Results, Compliance minimization, Eq. (6): ε is described as a small number used to avoid numerical singularity."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No Poisson's ratio is reported for the elastic material.",
      "readings": [
        "Constant ν=0.30.",
        "Constant ν=1/3."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Results, Compliance minimization, material description surrounding Eq. (6), and Methods, Finite Element Method (FEM) and gradient-based baselines, provide no Poisson's ratio."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The planar elasticity model is not identified as plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress.",
        "Plane strain."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Fig. 2a depicts a planar square; Results, Compliance minimization, and Methods, Finite Element Method (FEM) and gradient-based baselines, do not specify the constitutive reduction."
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No thickness or explicit per-unit-thickness convention is supplied for the planar elastic model.",
      "readings": [
        "Use unit thickness.",
        "Use uniform thickness t=0.1L."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Fig. 2a and the Results, Compliance minimization, setup describe only in-plane geometry; the FEM methods give no thickness."
    }
  ]
}
